name: LuSEE-Night
full_name: Lunar Surface Electromagnetics Experiment at Night
mission: CLPS CS-3 / Firefly Blue Ghost Mission 2
lander: Firefly Blue Ghost (powers off before nightfall)
org: UC Berkeley SSL / DOE BNL & LBNL
note: 2024 SPIE/arXiv 2407.07173 is the latest printed set. CDR 12.4 W / 6500 Wh / 87.5 kg is older_design_cdr_2023 — dated bound, not mixed into 2024 store/hours/mass. Geometry A_rad/e*/G OPEN → declared bracket, no middle.
electrical_model: Same heat-balance as ICES Fig.14: P_elec = max(P_electronics, P_leak); heater only makes up P_leak − P_electronics. 2024 arXiv 2407.07173: IEA insulation + self-generated heat at night; thermal switch to the parabolic radiator is open. No single P_night printed. Do not add electronics on top of leak.
witness_note: none flown — firefly_blue_ghost_m2_lusee_night is planned (lander off before nightfall; payload through the night). BGM2 has not landed.
killer_both_live_tail: OPEN geometry does not kill 7160 Wh under the dated 12.4 W bound plus this declared leak. 2024 P_night stays OPEN.
killer_disagree: OPEN geometry bracket. Tight corner LIVE; lossy declared corner DIE. 2024 P_night still OPEN.
thermal_hold_md: arXiv 2407.07173: battery must stay approximately −5 °C to +30 °C (268–303 K) or it cannot recharge at dawn. Court night hold is the printed pack floor −5 °C (derived 268.15 K). Lunar surface at the LuSEE-Night landing site falls as low as 100 K at night (quoted); day 390 K. Thermal switch to the radiator is open at night; temperature is held by insulation plus self-generated heat. Powersave enables a low-power heater — watt not printed.
alloy_md: 2024 print does not name a structure alloy. OPEN. CDR (older) names aluminum stages and Kevlar IEA suspend — not mixed into this line as flight k. No NIST map. k_path is a declared unit split so P_cond = G·ΔT.
honesty_md: 7160 Wh is 2024 nameplate, not usable. ConOps 30% SOC and 8% minimum SOC are printed. 12.4 W is CDR 2023. Do not average with 2024 component loads. PDR 8225 Wh is a third dated set, unused here. Nameplate 7160/328 = 21.83 W is not a survival line.

electronics_bracket.honesty: P_night 2024 NOT PRINTED. lo = older_design_cdr_2023 12.4 W. hi OPEN. BREAK = 7160/328 W.
electronics_bracket.lo_cite: Zenodo CDR 8173058 Fig.3.12: night total 12.4 W (preamp 2 W + IEA 10.4 W). Older design. Not arXiv 2407.07173.
electronics_bracket.hi_cite: 2024 arXiv 2407.07173 prints no single P_night. Night-core constant loads are listed separately; they are not a duty-cycled average and are not this line's P_electronics.
electronics_bracket.iff_dated_note: 2024 paper does not print night power; 2023 CDR printed 12.4 W for an older design.

battery_mass_kg.cite: arXiv 2407.07173: 50 kg of the 128 kg is the battery.

SOC_min_aggressive_pct.quote: The minimum safe battery bus voltage, at which the battery can be safely recharged, is taken here to be 24 V, which occurs at 8% SOC.
SOC_min_aggressive_pct.cite: arXiv 2407.07173 §4.1 / Fig.10: minimum safe recharge at 24 V occurs at 8% SOC.

SOC_min_conops_pct.quote: For the ConOps plan developed for LuSEE-Night, we set our minimum SOC to be 30%, for a minimum bus voltage of ∼28 V.

duty_cycle_night.quote: Here we show that it will be necessary to duty cycle the spectrometer, as there is insufficient stored power for continuous observations.
duty_cycle_night.cite: arXiv 2407.07173 Fig.10 caption: duty cycle required; insufficient stored power for continuous operation.

usable_conops_Wh.cite: derived usable at printed ConOps 30% SOC reserve. Nameplate 7160 is not usable.

usable_floor_Wh.cite: derived usable at printed 8% minimum SOC. 7160×(1−0.08)=6587.2 Wh.

charge_discharge_eff_pct.quote: We also include charging and discharging efficiencies of 95%, and an uncertainty margin on the total power load of 10%.
charge_discharge_eff_pct.cite: arXiv 2407.07173 §4.1 / Fig.9: charging and discharging efficiencies of 95%. Night ladder applies discharge once (applied_once_OPEN_direction); start-of-night assumed at nameplate.

power_load_uncertainty_margin_pct.quote: We also include charging and discharging efficiencies of 95%, and an uncertainty margin on the total power load of 10%.
power_load_uncertainty_margin_pct.cite: arXiv 2407.07173 §4.1 / Fig.9: uncertainty margin on the total power load of 10%.

P_keepalive_W.page_or_figure: §4.1 constant loads; Fig. 12 modes — no single average watt
P_keepalive_W.close_with: Printed 2024 Science/Powersave average night watt. Do not treat CDR 12.4 W as 2024 flight. Do not sum §4.1 components into one watt.

P_electronics_older_design_cdr_W.cite: Zenodo CDR 8173058 Fig.3.12 night 12.4 W. Dated older design. Court uses this only as the lo electronics bound.

H_night_h.cite: arXiv 2407.07173: battery must power the instrument throughout 328 hours of lunar night.

T_box_C.cite: arXiv 2407.07173: battery temperature must be maintained between approximately −5 °C and +30 °C. Night hold uses the printed floor.

T_box_K.cite: derived from printed −5 °C (arXiv 2407.07173). Paper also prints 268 K.

T_env_K.cite: arXiv 2407.07173: at night they fall as low as 100 K at the LuSEE-Night landing site.

T_env_C.cite: derived from printed 100 K night surface (arXiv 2407.07173). Not printed as celsius.

T_surface_day_K.cite: arXiv 2407.07173: day surface as high as 390 K at the landing site.

site_lat_deg.cite: arXiv 2407.07173 solar track: Lunar latitude −23.815°. 2301.10345 prints 23.813°S — not averaged; 2024 value used.

lander_off.cite: arXiv 2407.07173: lander and other payloads permanently shut down at end of first solar day. Firefly BGM2: Blue Ghost powers off prior to lunar nightfall.

enclosure_m.cite: arXiv 2407.07173 Fig.1: enclosure approximately 1 m × 1 m × 0.7 m.

eps_eff.close_with: Printed 2024 radiator/MLI e*. CDR preamp MLI 0.02 is older_design and another path — not used as 2024 e*.

k_ins_W_mK.close_with: Printed 2024 insulation k. Court conduction is G·ΔT; k_ins is not invented.

A_ins_m2.close_with: Printed insulation area. Enclosure 1×1×0.7 m is not A_ins.

A_rad_m2.page_or_figure: parabolic radiator named; area not printed
A_rad_m2.close_with: Printed radiator area (m²). Do not invent a radiator area. Do not mix CDR 0.2695 or PDR 0.70.

A_path_m2.close_with: Printed conductive cross-section. P_cond uses declared G.

L_path_m.close_with: Printed conductive length. Court uses DECLARED_UNIT L=1 m so A_path = G/k_unit.

dust_g_m2.page_or_figure: §3 5% PV area EOL — not radiator soiling
dust_g_m2.close_with: Printed dust mass on the radiator. 5% PV EOL is solar, not this thermal law. Do not invent a dust mass.

strut_alloy.close_with: Printed 2024 structure alloy. CDR aluminum/Kevlar is older_design.

night_strategy.value: internal battery + IEA insulation + self-heat; thermal switch open at night; PV day charge; lander off
night_strategy.cite: arXiv 2407.07173 §2 and §4.2. NASA CS-3: internal battery and self-heating. Firefly: lander off, payload up to two years.

geometry_bracket.honesty: DECLARED_BRACKET. A_rad, e*, G, A_ins, k_ins, dust OPEN. No middle. Radiator area is not printed.

G_path_W_per_K.lo_cite: Zenodo CDR 8173058 PALETTE thermal-switch OFF 0.002 W/K. Older design; 2024 says the switch is open, no G printed.
G_path_W_per_K.hi_cite: DECLARED_BRACKET: 2024 conduction G not printed. hi = 0.010 W/K declared extra night path. Not LEMS 0.006.

eps_eff.lo_cite: OPEN lower bound — 2024 does not print a floor on e*.
eps_eff.hi_cite: DECLARED_BRACKET: 2024 e* not printed. Not LEMS 0.0028. Not CDR preamp 0.02 mixed as 2024.

A_rad_m2.cite: DECLARED_BRACKET: radiator area not printed. lo 0.10 m² declared small panel. hi 1.0 m² = one printed 1 m × 1 m top face as OPEN upper. Not CDR 0.2695. Not PDR 0.70.

L_path_m.cite: DECLARED_UNIT so A_path = G/k_unit. P_cond = G·ΔT is independent of the A/L split.

k_path.cite: 2024 structure alloy NOT PRINTED. No NIST map. k_unit=1 W/m-K only so A_path = G·L. no measurement by us.

holes.note: arXiv 2407.07173 does not name a structure alloy. CDR aluminum/Kevlar is older_design.
